core_obligations: Refine the given covering to a standard affine cover of Spec(A) factoring through the given affines (proof lines 1714-1719).
Apply base change to see each refined associated functor is adequate (proof lines 1720-1723).
Assemble them into an adequate product functor over A' using the product lemma (proof lines 1724-1728).
Identify that product functor with F_{F,A'} via the Zariski sheaf condition, and descend to A (proof lines 1728-1734).
proof_roadmap: Base change and the product functor (proof lines 1720-1728).
The sheaf condition and descent (proof lines 1728-1734).
difficulty_reason: For an adequate O-module F on (Sch/S)_tau, the lemma asserts that the functor F_{F,A} attached to every affine scheme Spec(A) over S is adequate (statement lines 1706-1711). The proof takes a tau-covering by affine schemes over which the associated functors are adequate, refines it to a standard affine cover of Spec(A) whose members factor through the given ones, uses base change of adequate functors to see each refined functor is adequate, packages them into a single adequate product functor over the product ring by the product lemma, identifies that product functor with F_{F,A'} using the sheaf property of F for the Zariski topology, and finally applies the descent lemma for adequacy over the tau-covering Spec(A') -> Spec(A) (proof lines 1713-1734). The level is H3: a four-step reduction in which each step names the input that makes it work, including the sheaf condition that identifies the product functor.
